analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($97,810) vs SMA5 ($100,089)/SMA20 ($104,604)/SMA50 ($121,895) — below short/mid-term trends, bearish.
· Position vs SMA100 ($109,906)/SMA200 ($87,924) — mixed long-term trend, above SMA200.
· 52-week position (50.6%) + current price range historically neutral.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (47.7→42.5) — entering oversold territory, downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1053.4699→345.3040) — weak trend continuing, attempting to find a bottom.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower Band $88,488) — approaching lower band, 30.81% band width indicates expanding volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($82,710) — based on 20-day low, key defense line if price falls.
· Swing Resistance ($126,140) — high level relative to 52-week high, breakout signals bullish reversal.
· 5-day High ($105,660)/Low ($95,720), 20-day High ($124,395)/Low ($82,710) — 5-day low > 20-day low → potential Higher Low formation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.51x) — below 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) — RSI entering oversold and MACD attempting improvement, maintaining wait-and-see due to lack of volume.
